name: Niinuma Suzu
source:
[A Cheerful and Energetic Childhood Friend, Reunited After Seven Years]

Another childhood friend Reiichi reunites with in the ruins of Shinjumachi.
She’s one year younger than Haruna, and after the disaster seven years ago, her family left the town, cutting off all contact with both Reiichi and Haruna since then.

She’s the same as ever—an upbeat, energetic mood-maker and a hard worker.
Even in the now otherworldly Shinjumachi, she doesn’t let fear get the best of her and keeps Reiichi and the others motivated with her natural positivity.
She's a sociable girl with many friends, always in tune with the latest trends, but surprisingly, she’s a bit of a grandma’s girl, well-versed in old games and folktales.

Back when she lived in Shinjumachi, there weren’t many other kids around,
so she often tagged along with Reiichi and Haruna when they played.
It seems she happened to run into Haruna just as she was heading back to Shinjumachi and insisted on coming along… ?

"Mmm~! This feels like we’ve gone back in time, I’m so happy!"
